newsitem.title: USA: Massachusetts reaches agreement with Prudential.
newsitem.headline: Massachusetts reaches agreement with Prudential.

text.p: The Massachusetts Department of Insurance on Thursday said it has reached an agreement in principle with Prudential Insurance Co of America over complaints about the company's sales practices.
Additional information about the agreement was not immediately available.
Massachusetts was one of four states that had opposed a class-action settlement and an earlier settlement reached by a multistate taskforce of insurance regulators.
All but one of those states on Thursday said they had reached settlement agreements with Prudential.
In Florida, Prudential agreed to pay $15 million to resolve complaints there. Florida agreed to drop racketeering charges against Prudential.
Texas said it had reached an agreement with Prudential, but additional details were not immediately available.
California said it still opposed Prudential's settlements and declined to comment on whether it was in talks with Prudential about a possible agreement.
